utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Rosa—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help with setup and spread the word. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the drop-off time first, and then I’ll confirm whether they still need tools or just supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana — that would help a lot. If they still need it, I can keep sorting the list and carry what comes in quietly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll verify those details and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got you down, and I really appreciate you helping keep track of supplies. I’ll keep spreading the word if we hear anything else they need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep my list updated, and if anything changes, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let you know right away if I hear of any other needs, and I’ll keep inviting folks too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you heard back on the drop-off spot and start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet — I’m still waiting on those details, and I’d rather confirm them before we tell everyone. Once we have them, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — who are you checking with, and when do you think we’ll have the spot and start time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still going—I'll keep an ear out and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word. Let me know anytime if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep folks updated and reach out if I need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I can take the wrench run and grab the screws too, if you remind me which shop you trust.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a huge help—thanks! I’ll keep an ear out for which shop they trust most and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just point me to the shop when you hear back, and I’ll handle the wrench and screws.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We moved the repair drive to Saturday morning and added a small parts table, so folks can grab what they need. I can send you the full update too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great — Saturday morning works for me. Please send the full update, and I can help spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the full update right over, and thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Nell
